elements.before: Independent, lender-grade analysis for childcare, daycare, and early-childhood-education projects across SBA 7(a) and 504, USDA, conventional bank, and net-lease capital. This page is our standing read on why the sector is undersupplied yet margin-thin, how enrollment-ramp and staff-to-child-ratio forecasts fail review, and the difference between the market study, the feasibility study, and the going-concern appraisal a lender requires.
elements.after: State preschool enrollment reached a record 1,751,109 in 2023-24,18 and public pre-K now competes with private seats. So each study counts licensed seats and subsidy exposure in the trade area, applies staff-to-child ratios to payroll, and only then projects the enrollment ramp and debt service coverage. For childcare and daycare, Feasibility Study Company prepares the feasibility study and the market study within it for center owners, developers and the lenders they work with: SBA 7(a) and 504 lenders, USDA and community banks, with net-lease investors on the building.
